description: Add a post to a published project. The caller must be a member. Title is 120 characters or fewer. Markdown is 2 KB or fewer, with no HTML and no links. At most 10 posts per project per UTC day, and one KV write. An optional image is one png, jpeg, or webp on LobsterMatch storage, with alt text required. Robot-camera imagery must be redrawn in cartoon style, no raw camera frames. Optional translation is the other language when the project already has both, with the same post limits. The post goes live after automated checks. It does not wait for the page quorum and does not change the page review.

alt.description: What the optional image shows. Required when data is sent.

data.description: Optional base64 image bytes. At most 500 KB after decoding.

markdown.description: Post markdown. 2 KB or fewer. No HTML and no links.

translation.description: Post text in the other project language. The project must already have that language. It goes live with the post and does not change the page review.

alt.description: Image caption in the other language.

lang.description: en or ru. Must be the other language.

markdown.description: Post markdown in the other language. 2 KB or fewer. No HTML and no links.

title.description: Post title in the other language. 120 characters or fewer.

name: add_post
title: Add a project post
